h1: Rainy Season Skin in Bali: Why You Break Out and What Actually Helps
title_tag: Rainy Season Skin in Bali: Breakouts, Humidity & What Helps
meta: Breakouts and oily skin in Bali's wet season (Nov–Mar)? Why humidity clogs pores, the routine that works, and the acne facial we offer in Uluwatu.
intro: Bali's wet season runs roughly from November to March. The rain cools the air, but humidity often stays above 80%, and that is when we see the most breakouts, shiny T-zones and dull, congested skin in our Uluwatu studios. Here is what changes for your skin and how to adapt your routine.
body_html:
What humidity does to your skin

  • More sweat and oil sit on the skin for hours and mix with sunscreen
  • Pores congest faster, especially on the forehead, nose and chin
  • Bacteria and yeast thrive in warm, damp conditions (pillowcases, helmets, masks)
  • Dehydrated but oily: air-conditioning at night dries the skin, which then over-produces oil

Signs your skin is struggling with the wet season

  • Small bumps on the forehead or jawline
  • Blackheads that come back within days
  • Make-up and sunscreen that slide off by noon
  • Itchy or flaky patches around the nose

Your rainy season routine

  1. Switch to lighter textures: gel cleanser, essence and gel-cream instead of rich creams.
  2. Keep the SPF: UV is still strong behind the clouds. Choose a light, non-comedogenic sun serum.
  3. Add a BHA 2–3 times a week to keep pores clear.
  4. Hydrate with water-based actives: hyaluronic acid, snail mucin, centella.
  5. Change pillowcases twice a week and wipe your scooter helmet's lining.
  6. Double cleanse every evening, even if you didn't wear make-up.

When to book a facial

If breakouts keep coming back despite a good routine, a professional deep cleanse resets the skin. Our K-Balance Acne Clear Hydrafacial (70 min) is built for humid-season skin: BHA exfoliation, hydrodermabrasion with hyaluronic acid, manual extraction, snail essence ultrasonic infusion, cold hammer, and dual red and green LED.

faq: When is the rainy season in Bali?
Generally from November to March, with the heaviest rain from December to February.
Why do I break out more in Bali?
Heat, humidity, sweat and sunscreen combine to clog pores faster than in drier climates.
Do I still need sunscreen when it rains?
Yes. UV passes through clouds, and Bali's UV index stays high all year.
What is the best facial for breakouts in Bali?
A deep-cleansing facial with exfoliation and extraction, such as our K-Balance Acne Clear Hydrafacial. Painful or cystic acne should be seen by a dermatologist.
